hero.caption:
The memorial is situated at the top of Kegworth cemetery on Whatton Road in the village.  It consists of several engraved stones listing all 47 names; as well as information about the disaster, a dedication from the people of Kegworth and a Bible verse taken from Romans chapter 8, verses 38 and 39.
There is also seating around the back of the main stone for private contemplation, out of sight of the main cemetery.

There are other memorials in the village including a plaque on the Ashby Road bridge above the M1 motorway, close to where the plane came down; and a memorial bench, also near the scene, to commemorate the 30th anniversary. The Kegworth cemetery forms the main memorial.
